## Checklist

- [ ] The implementing worker is not the sole reviewer (self-review is L0).
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated for a meaningful semantic change.
- [ ] If the set of workstreams, the main line, or a standing policy changed, `PROJECT_STATUS.md` is updated.
- [ ] Ready and merge are left to the human (ADR #90).
